summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature in the MONAI repo; nothing committed and no tests run (edit-and-read only). Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coords) pairs with coords computed inline from padded slices; set_rnd skips keys starting with "__"; docstring Yields/Note added), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter with ensure_tuple start_pos, NumpyPadMode validation at construction, and iter_patch delegation; GridPatchDataset reworked to (dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates) with worker split via np.ceil, exact NotImplementedError for missing len, and apply_transform with map_items=False; math import removed; PatchDataset docstring uses dtype=float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus test_missing_len). Unverified: pytest was not run, so the pinned patch values and docstring example output are unconfirmed. Lines in edited regions are within 120 characters; three pre-existing long lines in get_valid_patch_size were left untouched. Assumption: test_loading_array uses np.arange(16) float images for both items, chosen because it is consistent with the pinned values.
